slides.texte_overlay:
habits i wish i knew sooner
that made me ultra feminine

moving slowly

i started doing everything a little slower, like walking, pouring tea, turning a page. slowness gives you a soft, magnetic grace that people notice right away.

speaking softly

i lowered my voice and stopped rushing my words. people lean in to listen when your energy is calm, and every conversation starts to feel more gentle.

having unexpected stories

i always have a strange myth or a beautiful fact ready to share. having unexpected stories in conversation makes me feel elegant, curious and interesting.
slides.texte_sophia:
having unexpected stories

i always have a strange myth or a beautiful fact to share. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and having unexpected stories makes me feel so elegant.

slides.texte_overlay:
protecting my peace

i stopped joining every drama and argument around me. nothing feels more feminine to me than calmly choosing peace over chaos, again and again, every day.

little rituals

i turned boring chores into small rituals with candles, music and nice cups. it makes ordinary days feel softer and makes me feel like the main character.
